Lanka Children’s and Youth Theatre Foundation
(1) The affairs of the Corporation shall, subject to the

column1: rules  of  the  Corporation  for  the  time  being  in  force,  be
administered by a Council of Management consisting of seven
persons as may be provided for in such rules and elected or
nominated in accordance with such rules. The term of office
of the Council of Management shall be two years.

column2: (2) The first Council of Management of the Corporation

column1: shall consist of the members of the Council of Management of
the  Foundation  holding  office  on  the  day  immediately
preceding the date of commencement of this Act, such Council
shall hold office until a Council of Management is elected or
nominated in accordance of the rules of the Corporation for
the time being inforce.

column2: (1) The membership of the Corporation shall consist

column1: of ordinary members and associate members.

column2: (2) The Council may, however subject to the rules of the

column1: Corporation for the time being inforce, admit as members, of
such classes and with such privileges and obligations as it
may prescribe, persons not eligible as ordinary members or
associate members.

column2: (3)  A  separate  register  of  associate  members  shall  be

column1: maintained  and  they  shall  enjoy  the  same  privileges  as
ordinary members but shall not be eligible to vote at meetings
of the Corporation.

column2: (1) It shall be lawful for the Corporation from time to

column1: time  at  any  general  meeting  and  by  the  majority  of  two-
thirds of the members qualified to vote, to make rules, not
inconsistent  with  the  provisions  of  this  Act,  or  any  other
written  law  for  the  management  of  the  affairs  of  the
Corporation (including the holding of meetings, transaction
of business at meetings, the preparation of the annual reports
&c,.) and the accomplishment of its objects.
